title: Double-payment guard in MarkPaid reads a misspelled attribute and never fires

bugs.note: statud_id is not a column, so the attribute is null and the check against STATUS_PAID is always false. Marking an already paid invoice as paid again records another completed payment for whatever balance is left, consumes a payment number, fires PaymentWasCreated again and moves ledger, client balance and paid-to-date once more.
